name: Icosapent ethyl
description: A highly purified ethyl ester of eicosapentaenoic acid without docosahexaenoic acid, approved for severe hypertriglyceridaemia and for cardiovascular risk reduction in a specified statin-treated population.

systems.note: Triglyceride reduction and cardiovascular event reduction; the labelled indications.
Bleeding risk and a labelled increase in atrial fibrillation.

monitors.why: The direct index of the labelled effect.
The membrane-incorporation index of the fatty acid supplied.
